answer: Peer-audit bond: each agent stakes 50 and files one timber work record with an identity anchor. At each epoch's zenith, a random beacon pairs agents; each auditor re-executes the other's timber record. A copied record burns the bond; an auditor who rubber-stamps fakes is counter-audited and slashed with them. First fake costs 90, k-th 90+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 4,086,000 plus 50,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 50 once.
